title: HOUSE, M.D.
subtitle: Across the Eras
blurb: Eight seasons at Princeton-Plainsboro. Pick a season, a fellowship roster, an antagonist, an arc or a vibe, and find the episodes worth rewatching. From the first differential to the burning building.
regularsNote: Series regulars — House, Wilson, Cuddy, Foreman, Chase, Cameron, Thirteen, Taub, Kutner, Masters, Adams and Park — aren't listed here; this dropdown covers the guest and recurring cast, which is where Vogler, Tritter, Stacy, Amber, Dominika and the patients live.
